name: Manamusume to no Papakatsu Ecchi ~Dame tte Ittemo, Kimochii Desho♪~
original_name: 愛娘とのパパ活エッチ～ダメって言っても、気持ちいいでしょ♪～
source:
Karin asks her father for some extra pocket change, but he denies her and tells her to go get a job.

She has always been a bit of a fathercon, though, and decides change his mind by flirting her way into a job providing some "extra service" for Papa.
